name: Portcullis (grey-box prefab)
notes: An iron grille that rises into the wall above the grey-box doorway (mw-e03.18; the Chapel of Echoes portcullis in chapel-portcullis.json is one). Moved only by signals (a lever, a cut rope), never by hand. Two seconds to rise or fall. It drops with a 2 kJ crush: pottery and wooden barricades break under it, while anything sturdier (a crate with its default unbreakable threshold, a stone block) wedges it open, which is the creative way to keep it up. A grille, so light, gas and sound pass through it even when it is down. A loud 75 dB rattle of chain and iron when it starts to move.
